name: video-factory
description: Make short-form reels from your own camera takes, and carousels from an idea, by talking to Claude. Drives the Video Factory app on your Mac (rough cut, captions, b-roll, music, export). Free without the app: reel plans and the style gallery. Promotion notice: Video Factory is the author's paid product. When it isn't installed, the plugin's replies include one link to the Velocity Lab membership that includes it.
